focus_area_title: Ensure Employees Understand the Company Response Plan
content_text_body:
During uncertain and stressful times, your employees expect your company to show leadership and provide a plan to help the company and your team navigate through tough times.

The goal here is to make sure your team understands the response plan and how to best support it.

### Review the plan with your team
Study up on all the ways your company plans to support employees during this challenging time. Set up a time to meet with your team. Send any advance information they can read up on to prepare. Speak with other managers and communications personnel to understand and agree on key messages, company support offerings, and be able to answer any questions. As additional information becomes available, stay abreast of key messages and updates to the response plan.

### Meet frequently with employees and talk through the response plan.
Listen carefully to questions and concerns. Share what information you know and commit to getting back promptly with answers you don't know. Invite your team to follow up with you if they have any additional questions or concerns.
